note: Illinois DNR park at Metropolis, Illinois' first state park, above the Ohio River. The campground's two loops are in woods about 350 m from the river; boat dock and launch ramp on the river. The replica 1802 fort is closed pending structural rehabilitation (noted 2026-11). --Claude
